notes.title: Treasure Hunters: Prologue - v1.2 Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello Dear Adventurers,[/p][p][/p][p]In this update, I mostly reworked everything related to clients. Most of the objects used to work server side so clients used to wait for a bit of time to get a feedback from anything. With this update most of the gears, items, mechanics etc. works client sided. So clients will get an instant feedback even if they have very high pings. Here are the changes I made in this update:[/p][p][/p][p][b]FEATURES:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Added a more clear tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Ranged Enemies will miss by chance if is lightened by a flashlight (for example, you can point a flashlight at a mosquito to miss when they shoot)[/p][/*][*][p]Random treasures spawn system by specified rarity[/p][/*][*][p]Lever has two notifications for cooldown and for stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Inspectable Paper better rotation (F*CKING FINALLY)[/p][/*][*][p]High Ping Warning for clients[/p][/*][*][p]Players spawn blood particles when get damaged[/p][/*][*][p]Less report noise call from footsteps[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes on enemies' hearing settings[/p][/*][*][p]Now the overall treasure value for a dungeon is multiplied by the DungeonGrowth OverallTreasureValue * (TileAmount/ExpectedTileAmount)[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]CLIENT SIDED REWORKS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hit Feedback Client side[/p][/*][*][p]InspectableItems are now client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Yohu's Heart is client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Artifact Holder picking up is client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Door Opening Effects are client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Coffin opening is client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Halucination Objects are now Works client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Incenses Work client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Openable secret chambers now work client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Drain now Works client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Glowing Button now Works client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Holdable Valve now works client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Pickupable objects disappears immedieately for clients before spawning in their hand. (Faster Feedback)[/p][/*][*][p]Blowing Dart only works for client bug is fixed (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Flashlight now works client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Rarity Detector turkish characters are missing[/p][/*][*][p]Rarity Detector now works client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Dropping Objects are now client sided (faster feedback right after pressing G)[/p][/*][*][p]Gun hitbacks are now client sided.[/p][/*][*][p]Switching Items now works on client side[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Main artifact doesnt count at the end bug is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Removed "Change mesh" object from game[/p][/*][*][p]Pushing a player without kicking them bug is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies interact with keys bug is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Sack can duplicate items bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Friends button doesnt work after a friend join bug is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Spectator ui text fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Weird animation while picking up animation while crouching is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up animation on client doesnt work[/p][/*][*][p]While crouching and sliding, not falling of edges bug is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed seeing head while swimming[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flame traps not working sometimes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed moving logs in DeathRun room (in full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Mirrors turning slower on low fps bug is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Internet connection pop up, bux is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Squeezer trap going through the wall bug[/p][/*][*][p]Weird gates in lava pit room is fixed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That was a busy ass week, and it will be even busier for the next couple of weeks, but I'm dedicated to bringing your dream Co-op Indy game to reality. [/p][p][/p][p]Please don't forget to leave a review on Steam, give feedback [/p][h3][b]AND DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST THE FULL GAME:[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Treasure Hunters: Prologue - Hotfix 3
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone, again thanks to your feedback I was able to fix some major and minor bugs. And here are some of them. Also the voice chat works properly now. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Newly Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased pistol range[/p][/*][*][p]Increased fire rest duration on flame traps[/p][/*][*][p]Added microphone threshold[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Symbol rocks used to collide with player and disappear now they don't (thanks to [b]rhavegn and[/b] [b][u]龍龍uwu[/u][/b] in discord)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed spikes on the walls going through each other[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input devices duplication[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input device changing every time opening the options screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pressure pads inside the spike ceiling room, causing players to be stuck out[/p][/*][*][p]Inspectable papers used to push pickup items and pickups would disappear, now they don't[/p][/*][*][p]Added a collision at the back of the pickup[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed, moving stone disappears which is going up in a coop light puzzle room [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dungeon generator removes the last room at the beginning[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much for helping me improving the game, you can DM whenever you want on discord in case you encounter a bug. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Also please remember to wishlist the full game[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Treasure Hunters: Prologue - v1.1 Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello Dear Adventurers, [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks all of you for your feedbacks. They are helping me update the game much much faster. In this update I added some little helpful features and fixed some major bugs. [/p][h3][b]Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added Information Popups[/p][/*][*][p]Added loading screen right after pressing Start Game[/p][/*][*][p]Added change icon on map selector[/p][/*][*][p]NOW YOU CAN CLOSE OPTIONS MENU WITH PRESSING ESC!![/p][/*][*][p]Increased the default graphic options[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed 4 people can’t join bug (Thanks to [b]asd4916134,  [/b]their friends[b] [/b]for reporting this bug)[/p][/*][*][p]Squeezing Wall not synched bug is  fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Objects fallingthrough terrain is “mostly” fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rarity detector’s characters[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed doors are showing up on in rooms with no exit (for clients)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed keys spawning on rooms with no doors[/p][/*][*][p]You can jump onto these shelves and clip through the tent[/p][/*][*][p]Flickering textures in spike ceiling room[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up the artifact without switching bug is fixed[/p][/*][/list][p]Again thanks to all of you and don't forget, keep hunting.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]And remember to add the full game to your wishlist[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
